item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President invokes his authority and introduces the directions that follow; this segment contains no independent change to legal rights or status.","evidence":"it is hereby ordered as follows"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately establishes and staffs an internal executive council and directs its chairman to invite other agency heads when relevant, all as executive organization and management.","evidence":"There is hereby established the President's Council on Physical Fitness and Sports"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The Council is directed to develop policies promoting, coordinating, assisting, and studying physical-fitness programs; no specified legally consequential agency outcome is mandated.","evidence":"The Council shall develop policies designed to"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately establishes and specifies the membership structure of an advisory committee, an internal organizational action.","evidence":"There is hereby established the Citizens Advisory Committee on Physical Fitness and Sports"},{"segment_id":"5","code":3,"rationale":"Although the segment also assigns internal chairmanship and meeting arrangements, it itself establishes the members' compensation and statutory travel-reimbursement treatment, with the entitlement applying during their service.","evidence":"they shall be reimbursed for travel expenses, including per diem in lieu of subsistence"},{"segment_id":"6","code":1,"rationale":"The Committee is directed to advise, assist, evaluate, and recommend to the Council, which are internal advisory and review functions without a dictated legal outcome.","evidence":"The Committee shall advise and assist the Council in evaluating progress"},{"segment_id":"7","code":1,"rationale":"The segment assigns information-sharing, assistance, funding-source, administrative-service, construction, and continuity arrangements among executive entities; these are internal management provisions rather than changes to external legal rights.","evidence":"The Department of Health, Education, and Welfare shall furnish necessary administrative services for the Council."},{"segment_id":"8","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately makes a naming amendment to an earlier order concerning the Council's seal, an internal administrative amendment rather than a substantive legal consequence.","evidence":"is further amended by adding the words \"and Sports\""},{"segment_id":"9","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately revokes an earlier executive order governing this administrative body; under the codebook, such an administrative revocation is internal management.","evidence":"Executive Order 11074 of January 8, 1963, is hereby revoked."}]}
